note: Bu bir veri degil, KARAR dosyasidir. Kullanici belirler, LLM degil. us_pei_pack.py bunu instructions.md'nin basina koyar; skill aksi halde varsayim uretip 'state assumptions' der (idea-generation/references/workflow.md Bolum 1).
position_count_note: The screen decides how many names clear the bar. Note the consequence rather than working around it: fewer positions widen the band inside which luck alone explains the result.

horizon.note: A weekly review or a monthly rebalance may change the portfolio but neither is obliged to. Holding through both is a valid outcome.

liquidity_floor.reason: Measured on this universe 2026-08-09: the least liquid name trades USD 17m a day and the median USD 669m. A retail-sized position is well under a tenth of a percent of daily volume, so a liquidity screen would exclude nothing and only add a false constraint.

instruments: common equity only; no options, no leverage, no shorting
benchmark_note: No benchmark set yet. Do not assume one, and do not frame results as active weight against an index.
known_tension: The plugin's default fundamental horizon is 3-18 months while this mandate rebalances monthly. Measured in this repo: monthly decisions rest on data averaging 46 days old, and in 32% of company-months a new 10-Q or 10-K lands within 30 days of the decision. Filing-driven timing is the alternative; next_events carries the dates.
